decisions.reason: Archiving and reporting software is central to the firm's announced data-driven, web-based direction and has its own web page, so the investment and public commitment strongly favor keeping it.

This second archiving product overlaps with A and is only mentioned on the website, but it fits the digital strategy, so management would likely keep it or later merge it rather than drop it within a year.

The manhole door with safety railing has its own web page and extends the established hardware line, and safety equipment for municipal operators sells steadily, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
The floating sludge extractor builds on the core water-treatment machinery business, and any slow uptake can be attributed to long municipal procurement cycles, which supports persisting with it.
Control technology for water engineering machinery links the firm's machinery to its automation strategy and is central to its integrated-solutions direction, so it would be kept.
